 Reach-In Temperature & Climate Test Chamber Temp-& ClimeEvent 
Our ClimeEvent climate chamber is as innovative as it is sophisticated and offers you real added value in everyday testing. With increased humidification and dehumidification performance and a new type of control for even more precise humidity values - the perfect solution for testing the influence of temperature and humidity on the properties, function and service life of your products.
Experience in 3D!

This makes the ClimeEvent unique.
Also with new climate-friendly refrigerant R744
Our single-stage systems (down to -40°C) are equipped with CO2 refrigeration technology (GWP = 1). Even at -40°C, the system still offers sufficient power to operate your test material.
Connectivity is key.
Versatile thanks to our in-house Simpati software. Flexibility thanks to various interfaces (SimServ, interface, LabView, OPC-UA, ProfiBus, ProfiNET or EtherCAT). ASCII can still be used.
Even more precise humidity values and simple management of the humidification water.
Innovative absolute humidity control ensures control accuracy for climate change tests and extreme temperature and humidity combinations.
Large water bath for increased humidification and dehumidification performance.
25-litre water tank - automatic make-up included as standard.
Protect your valuable test material.
Triple test material fuse included as standard. Active test items can be deenergized via a potential-free contact. Test chamber can switch off in the event of a fault in the test material or be set to a defined value (optional).
Requirements from the defense sector
Whether you need to meet MIL standards or implement special applications such as the temperature control of ammunition in external test housings - our products offer solutions for a wide range of applications.
End-of-line testing
For 100% testing after production, particularly efficient loading and unloading are relevant, as well as integration into existing systems with OPC-UA or SECS/GEM. We offer individual solutions for this.
Explore the ClimeEvent.
LED status bar for a quick overview 
The LED bar shows the test progress in green. Warnings (orange) and alarms (red) are also displayed. A glance into the laboratory in the morning is enough to see the status of all systems. 
LED test room lighting
In the test chamber, there is an LED ceiling lighting. It ensures uniform and bright illumination, even when standing in front of the test chamber and blocking the incoming light with the upper body. 
Window in the door with optional privacy screen 
Often, a good view of the test specimen is important. Therefore, our chamber can be equipped with a heated and 5-fold glazed pane. Together with the bright LED lighting in the test room, they ensure clear visibility under all test conditions. Sometimes, however, it is also important to protect the test object from prying eyes. In this case, the pane becomes opaque at the push of a button (optional). 
Digital inputs and outputs
With this, the test object can be controlled via appropriate circuits. For example, it can be switched on and off via the digital channel using a relay. Optionally, a specific behavior of the test chamber can be programmed via the inputs. For example, in the event of solidification of the test object, the test chamber can be regulated to room temperature to prevent aging of the test object. 
Hardware test object protection
In addition to the software-side test object protection, the hardware test object protection is also included in the basic equipment. With its own Pt100 sensor and its own hardware, it is system-independent and can effectively protect the test object from incorrect temperatures in the event of a fault. 
USB and Ethernet 
In the basic equipment, a USB port for data recording (csv) and an Ethernet port are available. The cabinet can be controlled via the network connection with our software S!MPATI® or the data can be recorded. Additionally, the cabinet can also be controlled by external programs via our own protocol SimServ. 
Potential-free contact 
In the basic equipment, a potential-free contact is available. In the event of a malfunction of the test cabinet, the test object can be switched off via this contact. This can prevent an unacceptable temperature rise in the test chamber due to heat dissipation of the test object. 
Efficient humidification system 
Deep inside is our humidification system for climate tests. It is designed to be very robust against outgassing of the test object and does not require additional infrastructure such as compressed air. With the water bath, a large climate range can be covered. Only at very high humidification performances or low dew points are steam humidifiers or compressed air dryers required. 
Access Ports
The size, position, and design of our access ports are as individual as your test object and your tests. Talk to us. We have the right solution for every requirement. 
Foldable web panel 25.4 cm (10“) 
The 25.4 cm (10“) display is foldable. All settings can be made via the touch panel, and test programs can be conveniently programmed.
Water tank for climate tests 
For climate tests, there is a water tank below the test room door with a capacity of 27 liters. If a corresponding water supply is available (included in the basic equipment), it can be filled manually or automatically. Optionally, a demineralization unit can be installed. 
Mobile and undercarriage 
The test cabinet is designed to be transported with simple tools. Optionally, rollers are available, allowing the test cabinet to be moved without any tools. 
The ClimeEvent now also with climate-friendly refrigerant CO2 (R744).
Our single-stage systems (down to -40°C) are equipped with the innovative CO2 refrigeration technology (GWP <1).
Find out more!
GWP = 1 - future-proof testing!
Our CO2 systems provide powerful cooling down to -50°C.
No changes to the infrastructure necessary.
Compared to single-stage units (down to -40°C), often lower investment and operating costs.
Lower energy consumption, with ramp programmes between 120 °C and -40 °C.
For example, a CO2 test chamber consumes up to 30 % less energy than a cascade.
Significantly reduced sound pressure level.
We develop the optimum solution for your application.
Automotive: Demanding climate tests such as those from LV124 or general standards such as the IEC 60068 series pose no challenges for our test chambers. Not even in the field of e-mobility.
Electronics: Our test chambers are designed for a wide range of tests in the electronics industry and easily master these specific requirements; e.g. low-silicone test chamber.
5G and autonomous driving: There are often very specific requirements in this area. Special adaptations enable testing in the EMC area or of lidar sensors. 
Aeropace and defence: In this area, extreme demands are often placed on the product. Our chambers can be used to test corresponding standards from the aerospace or defence sector.
Consumer products: Consumer and luxury goods must also be tested. These sometimes pose special challenges for the test chambers, such as tests with leather, which introduces highly corrosive outgassing into the test chamber. Here too, we have already provided solutions for our customers on several occasions.
Special applications.
Lithium ions: Rechargeable batteries are installed in many devices these days, and e-mobility is also leading to an increased number of tests with batteries. To ensure that you can test these test items safely, our test chambers are equipped with a tested safety system based on the EUCAR Hazard Level System, which extends up to Hazard Level 7.
ATEX: Many test items use flammable substances as lubricants or operating fluids. A risk assessment is required in order to be able to test safely even in the event of a leak in the test material. If necessary, measures must be taken at the test chamber. We offer you advisory support and equip your test chamber with a tested safety concept.
ESD: Some test items are very sensitive to electrostatic charge. The test chambers can be equipped accordingly to prevent this from happening in the test chamber, for example through air movement. From the earthing point to the shielding of all installed components. 
EMC: The test chambers must be specially shielded to ensure that no signals are emitted from the test object into the environment or affect your test object. We have many years of experience in the construction of test chambers for EMC tests.
Corrosive gases: PCBs and plug connections in particular must be tested under conditions with corrosive gases. Appropriate equipment is also available for this purpose.
Stress screening test chambers for temperature and climatic tests
The Reach-In temperature and climate test chambers for stress screening tests are available as standard in the performance classes 10 K/min to 25 K/min. The ideal test chamber for the test specimen can be selected from sizes ranging from 270 to 1300 liters. Our ESS test chambers are specially developed for fast temperature cycles and moist heat tests and are used primarily in safety-critical sectors such as the aerospace, automotive, medical technology and defense industries.
Product options
Additional Access Ports
Access port made of stainless steel, vailable in three standard sizes Ø 50, 80, 125 mm, including 1 silicone plug closed and 1 foam + silicone plug, slotted.
Heavy-load rails
This option includes a modification of the test space and the exterior housing. Via special rails, the test specimen load is transferred from the test space to the exterior housing. Depending on the size, the surface load is up to 350 kg or 500 kg.
The test space height is reduced by 5°mm.
Temperature measurement on the test specimen
Many norms, such as the new version of IEC 60068-2-14 Nb, require close observation and recording of the temperature of the test specimen during the test phases. Our test chamber can be equipped with additional temperature sensors, the values from which are displayed and recorded on the display (via USB or with S!MPATI®). One of the sensors can also be used as a control sensor if required.
Water Cooling CO2
The following supply connections are mounted on the top:
Cooling water connection including optional insulation of water supply
Supply of demineralized water (Climate Test Chambers only)
Compressed air supply (available as additional equipment)
